name: Patty Murray
committees: Senate Health, Education, Labor and Pensions
stance: Backs federal AI regulation with independent oversight, and opposes blanket federal preemption of state AI laws.

statements.text: In Olympia, heard from Washington state leaders on their efforts to regulate AI and emphasized the need for federal action without preempting state AI laws.
Co-signed the Senate letter urging President Trump to negotiate frontier-AI guardrails and global standards with China and to consider a mutual pause in frontier AI development.

review.note: added October 2026 from murray.senate.gov / kaine.senate.gov primary sources
